title: Effect of Motorized Cryotherapy on Early Effusion, Swelling, and Pain After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction
brief_summary: To test the efficacy of motorized cryotherapy on early effusion, and pain after ACL reconstruction
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Acute ACL ruptured patient

Exclusion Criteria:

* Combined meniscal injury requiring surgery
* Combined ligament injury requiring surgery
* Combined chondral injury requiring surgery
* Previous surgery history on corresponding knee
* Allergic to cold
